import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from io import StringIO

# Create the dataset
data = """Person ID,Gender,Age,Occupation,Sleep Duration,Quality of Sleep,Physical Activity Level,Stress Level,BMI Category,Blood Pressure,Heart Rate,Daily Steps,Sleep Disorder
1,Male,27,Software Engineer,6.1,6,42,6,Overweight,126/83,77,4200,
2,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
3,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
4,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
5,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea"""

df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Fill empty sleep disorder values
df['Sleep Disorder'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')

# Set up the figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(15, 10))
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# Color palette
palette = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
colors = {'Normal': '#2ecc71', 'Overweight': '#f39c12', 'Obese': '#e74c3c'}
for bmi in df['BMI Category'].unique():
    subset = df[df['BMI Category'] == bmi]
    ax1.scatter(subset['Sleep Duration'], subset['Quality of Sleep'], 
                c=colors[bmi], label=bmi, s=100, alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black')
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)')
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by BMI')
ax1.legend()
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 2. Physical Activity Level by Occupation
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
occupation_activity = df.groupby('Occupation')['Physical Activity Level'].mean().sort_values()
bars = ax2.barh(occupation_activity.index, occupation_activity.values, color=palette[:len(occupation_activity)])
ax2.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level')
ax2.set_title('Avg Physical Activity by Occupation')
ax2.bar_label(bars, fmt='%.0f')

# 3. Sleep Disorder Distribution
ax3 = axes[0, 2]
disorder_counts = df['Sleep Disorder'].value_counts()
colors_pie = ['#3498db', '#e74c3c']
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(disorder_counts.values, labels=disorder_counts.index, 
                                    autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors_pie[:len(disorder_counts)],
                                    explode=[0.05]*len(disorder_counts))
ax3.set_title('Sleep Disorder Distribution')

# 4. Stress Level vs Heart Rate
ax4 = axes[1, 0]
scatter = ax4.scatter(df['Stress Level'], df['Heart Rate'], 
                      c=df['Daily Steps'], cmap='viridis', s=150, 
                      alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black')
ax4.set_xlabel('Stress Level')
ax4.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)')
ax4.set_title('Stress Level vs Heart Rate\n(color = Daily Steps)')
plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax4, label='Daily Steps')
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 5. Daily Steps by BMI Category
ax5 = axes[1, 1]
bmi_order = ['Normal', 'Overweight', 'Obese']
bmi_colors = [colors[bmi] for bmi in bmi_order if bmi in df['BMI Category'].values]
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='BMI Category', y='Daily Steps', ax=ax5, 
            order=[b for b in bmi_order if b in df['BMI Category'].values],
            palette=colors)
ax5.set_title('Daily Steps by BMI Category')
ax5.set_ylabel('Daily Steps')

# 6. Correlation Heatmap
ax6 = axes[1, 2]
numeric_cols = ['Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[numeric_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, cmap='coolwarm', center=0, ax=ax6,
            fmt='.2f', square=True, linewidths=0.5)
ax6.set_title('Correlation Matrix')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
plt.close()
